Minister for Sports and Youth Services Vakiti Srihari on Wednesday unveiled a replica of the official logo of the upcoming Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) at a function held in Madhira town of Khammam district.
He also released a brochure on the forthcoming sporting event.
Telangana is scheduled to host the eighth edition of the KIYG from December 11 to 22, 2026 at various venues in the State.
The national-level Archery competitions of the KIYG will be held at Sardar Patel Stadium in Khammam from December 17 to 20.
Speaking on the occasion, Mr. Srihari said the State government was making elaborate arrangements in coordination with various departments to ensure the successful conduct of KIYG-2026.
